final_message:
I scheduled four practice blocks totaling 3 hours 25 minutes. If you complete them, Milepost projects that all five skills will meet their targets for your cells exam at 2027-03-11T09:00:00-05:00.

- 2027-03-06T10:00:00-05:00 — Plant and animal cell organelles, 70 minutes
- 2027-03-07T10:00:00-05:00 — Diffusion and osmosis, 55 minutes
- 2027-03-09T07:00:00-05:00 — How the ER and Golgi make and ship proteins, 40 minutes
- 2027-03-10T07:00:00-05:00 — Diffusion and osmosis, 40 minutes

Diffusion and osmosis had the largest gap, so it gets two sessions. The fluid mosaic model and active transport are already projected to meet their targets on exam day without extra practice.
